channel.title: Perspectives by Fabiano Filho
channel.description: Essays by Fabiano Filho, MD, on artificial intelligence in medicine: clinical prediction, fairness, evaluation and what it takes to use AI well in health care.

item.title: The paper got cheap
item.description: A same-day desk rejection, an unusually frank editor and what it taught me: with AI agents the benchmark, the figures and the prose got cheap. The question did not.
